title: Champion of the Hundred Dynasties
summary: Lin Dong decides to destroy the core of the Heaven-Sealing Formation Diagram. He fights the revived Death Spirit General with Little Flame's help and passes three wind and thunder tribulations, rising from 1st Seal to 4th Seal Heaven Symbol Master. Using the Devouring Ancestral Symbol and the Stone Talisman, he takes in the tribulation lightning, then turns it and the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal on the formation core. The others join in, and to cover them Lin Dong strikes the wisp of Zheng Zhong's primordial spirit with Heavenly Dragon Energy. Ling Qingzhu of the Nine Heavens Taiqing Palace arrives, and Zheng Zhong retreats. The Super Sects make Lin Dong champion, and he turns down the Yuan Gate to join the Dao Sect. A month later the Lin Clan honours Lin Zhentian and the Yan City branch.
events: Lin Dong goes after the formation core and fights the Death Spirit General.
He passes three wind and thunder tribulations and becomes a 4th Seal Heaven Symbol Master.
He takes in the lightning with the Devouring Ancestral Symbol and the Stone Talisman and breaks the core.
Everyone attacks the core; Lin Dong strikes Zheng Zhong's primordial spirit to break the Space Prison.
Ling Qingzhu of the Nine Heavens Taiqing Palace drives Zheng Zhong off.
Lin Dong is named champion and chooses the Dao Sect over the Yuan Gate.
The Lin Clan raises Lin Zhentian to Supreme Elder and honours the Yan City branch.
cultivation: Lin Dong passes three wind and thunder tribulations and rises from 1st Seal to 2nd, 3rd and then 4th Seal Heaven Symbol Master. Zheng Zhong is at the Profound Life stage.
